title: Motion (Raman, Jurado - McOsker) relative to reports on: a City-wide expansion of public hygiene infrastructure, including toilets, hand washing stations,…
text:
[Council File 26-1513]
Motion (Raman, Jurado - McOsker) relative to reports on: a City-wide expansion of public hygiene infrastructure, including toilets, hand washing stations, and permanent water spigots; the public toilet program currently administered by the Bureau of Street Services; identification of funding for the operational Skid Row public toilets; and related matters. (This item is referred to the Public Works Committee and Homelessness and Health Committee.)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
